name: mwaa-serverless
description: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow Serverless provides a managed workflow orchestration platform for running Apache Airflow workflows in a serverless environment.

subcommands.name: create-workflow
subcommands.description: Creates a new workflow in Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow Serverless.

subcommands.name: delete-workflow
subcommands.description: Deletes a workflow and all its versions.

subcommands.name: get-task-instance
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific task instance within a workflow run.

subcommands.name: get-workflow
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a workflow, including its configuration, status, and metadata.

subcommands.name: get-workflow-run
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific workflow run, including its status, execution details, and task instances.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags that are associated with a specified Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow Serverless resource.

subcommands.name: list-task-instances
subcommands.description: Lists all task instances for a specific workflow run, with optional pagination support.

subcommands.name: list-workflow-runs
subcommands.description: Lists all runs for a specified workflow, with optional pagination and filtering support.

subcommands.name: list-workflow-versions
subcommands.description: Lists all versions of a specified workflow, with optional pagination support.

subcommands.name: list-workflows
subcommands.description: Lists all workflows in your account, with optional pagination support.

subcommands.name: start-workflow-run
subcommands.description: Starts a new execution of a workflow.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to an Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow Serverless resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow Serverless resource.

subcommands.name: update-workflow
subcommands.description: Updates an existing workflow with new configuration settings.
